definitions.explanation: An indefinite but small number of days, typically implying around two to five or six days. A slightly formal alternative to {何日|なんにち}か.

examples.japanese: {数日|すうじつ}⟦{後|ご}→後：30157_go⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{届|とど}きます→届く：00899_todoku⟧。
examples.english: It will arrive in a few days.

examples.japanese: {数日|すうじつ}⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{体調|たいちょう}→体調：04644_taichou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧。
examples.english: I have been feeling unwell since a few days ago.

examples.japanese: ⟦{出張|しゅっちょう}→出張：01094_shucchou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{数日|すうじつ}⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{空|あ}ける→空ける：18694_akeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{猫|ねこ}→猫：02237_neko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{世話|せわ}→世話：02088_sewa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{頼|たの}んだ→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧。
examples.english: Since I'll be away from home for several days on a business trip, I asked someone to look after my cat.

notes:
A common word meaning "several days." Composed of ⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧ (several/a few) + {日|じつ} (days). The prefix ⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧ can combine with many counters to mean "several" of that unit.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {数日|すうじつ}⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧: a few days ago
- {数日|すうじつ}⟦{後|ご}→後：30157_go⟧: in a few days
- {数日|すうじつ}{間|かん}: for several days
- {数日|すうじつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧わたって: over a span of several days

RELATED TERMS WITH {数|すう}:
- ⟦{数時間|すうじかん}→数時間：21622_suujikan⟧: several hours
- ⟦{数週間|すうしゅうかん}→数週間：21615_suushuukan⟧: several weeks
- 数か{月|げつ}: several months
- ⟦{数年|すうねん}→数年：28206_suunen⟧: several years
- ⟦{数人|すうにん}→数人：18787_suunin⟧: several people

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{何日|なんにち}→何日：23870_nannichi⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧: some days, a few days — more casual
- {二三日|にさんにち}: two or three days — more specific
- {数日|すうじつ}{間|かん}: for a period of several days — adds the time-span marker
